name: Bathyal-Moulin
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past active supervolcanoes, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
the buried megastructure still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
Whoever controls iron controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
